entities.name: Q1IK22 guanylate kinase
observations: 233-aa sequence is an exact match to reviewed UniProt Q1IK22 guanylate kinase from Koribacter versatilis.
Reference annotation identifies a guanylate kinase-like domain at residues 3–184 and an ATP-binding site at residues 10–17.

Sequence contains the P-loop-like motif APSGSGKS at residues 10–17 and guanylate-kinase-associated conserved regions LDIDVQ at 98–103 and PPS at 122–124; do not assign these latter regions as independent domains.
